item.title: 361 Flame 5 Running Shoe Review
item.author: davidm@rtings.com (David Marquez)
item.description: The 361 Flame 5 is a carbon-plated super shoe designed for marathon racing. Its impressively cushioned, highly propulsive ride drives you quickly through stride ...
item.content:encoded: The 361 Flame 5 is a carbon-plated super shoe designed for marathon racing. Its impressively cushioned, highly propulsive ride drives you quickly through stride and keeps legs well protected from road impact. It’s also unusually stable for a super shoe, giving runners a more trustworthy platform than most race-focused options. However, while it can handle workouts and short-distance racing decently, it isn't especially light or springy for a dedicated racer, and runners with sensitive heels or Achilles tendons may find the stiff, unpadded heel irritating.

item.title: ASICS HYPER SPEED 6 Running Shoe Review
item.author: johnc@rtings.com (John Cole)
item.description: The ASICS HYPER SPEED 6 is a budget lightweight trainer built for faster workouts. Its firm, low-profile feel will suit runners who want a shoe that's light and ...
item.content:encoded: The ASICS HYPER SPEED 6 is a budget lightweight trainer built for faster workouts. Its firm, low-profile feel will suit runners who want a shoe that's light and simple. But its basic foam lacks the cushioning and energy return that runners have come to expect from ASICS' shoes, and it feels unpleasant over longer distances.

item.title: Diadora Corsa Running Shoe Review
item.author: johnc@rtings.com (John Cole)
item.description: The Diadora Corsa is a high-stack daily trainer for runners who want one very good shoe to cover all weekly miles. Its lightweight build is trustworthy underfoot...
item.content:encoded: The Diadora Corsa is a high-stack daily trainer for runners who want one very good shoe to cover all weekly miles. Its lightweight build is trustworthy underfoot, and its deeply cushioned platform offers very good impact protection. It thrives on easy, relaxed miles, but can handle some faster running and even get you through a marathon if finishing is the goal. However, the ride isn't bouncy or energetic, which means it’s most at home during easy paces where comfort matters more than speed.

item.title: Sony ZV-1F Camera Review
item.author: sophiea@rtings.com (Sophie Arsenault)
item.description: The Sony ZV-1F is a compact vlogging camera and the most affordable sibling of the Sony ZV-1 II. It features a fixed 20mm full-frame-equivalent lens, making it w...
item.content:encoded: The Sony ZV-1F is a compact vlogging camera and the most affordable sibling of the Sony ZV-1 II. It features a fixed 20mm full-frame-equivalent lens, making it well-suited for vlogging. Like other cameras in Sony's ZV lineup, it has a portable design with a touchscreen, a three-capsule directional microphone, and Sony's latest vlogging features, including Product Showcase and Cinematic Vlog mode. The ZV-1F uses the same stacked 20MP 1-inch sensor found in the ZV-1 II. However, unlike the original Sony ZV-1, it lacks optical image stabilization and instead relies on digital stabilization to smooth out footage.

item.title: CMF Clip Pro Headphones Review
item.author: dagobietma@rtings.com (Dagobiet Morales Alfaro)
item.description: The CMF Clip Pro are open-ear, clip-on earbuds from Nothing's budget-minded headphone division. While the Clip Pro employ a similar cuff design to open-ear compe...
item.content:encoded: The CMF Clip Pro are open-ear, clip-on earbuds from Nothing's budget-minded headphone division. While the Clip Pro employ a similar cuff design to open-ear competitors, like the Shokz OpenDots 2, they come with some distinctive features that help them stand out from the crowd. These include LDAC compatibility for high-quality audio streaming, a leakage-reduction feature, and a unique case that comes equipped with an additional control, case-mounted control interface.
